name: 030-segment-through-rotated-land
why: A run driven ACROSS a land it never ends on. The 1.25x1.75 land at 270deg presents 1.75 across x and 1.25 across y, half-extents 0.875/0.625, inner core 0.625/0.375 after the 0.25mm corner radius. The centreline sits 0.2mm off the centre in y and spans the land in x, so it is inside the core.
